correctness.rationale: The proof derives the character through exact equivariant Alexander duality for the graph whose nonedges form a matching on each allowed face. Rotation orbits of order at least three cannot lie in the dual, the antipodal rotation has m individual pair faces, and all reflection-fixed faces are counted by proved vertex/edge-axis cancellation. The published shellability theorem guarantees only one reduced homology degree. The group average proves the invariant dimensions. Independent code cross-checks 165 dual-orbit, 122 direct cut-complex, and 30 Burnside cases; finite checks are supportive, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full dihedral module for all cycle powers is a canonical extension of the published full-power homotopy and cyclic-character theorems. The new all-power reflection formulas distinguish inequivalent geometric involutions, determine complete rational representations for every p>=3, and give the nontrivial uniform vanishing law for n congruent to 1 mod 4. These are not obtainable from ranks or cyclic restriction alone, and the result is not an arbitrary finite parameter increment.
